name: SutrulamApp_TravelPlanner
description: Sutrulam – An AI-powered travel planner for students and explorers! Plan city trips, intercity day trips, or full vacations with personalized, time-by-time itineraries. Built with Streamlit and Gemini API. Created for IBM x SkillsBuild Internship Course

paragraphs: Sutrulam (meaning “Trip” in Tamil) is an AI-powered travel planner app built for students who love exploring cities across India — or even around the world! Whether you're planning a weekend getaway, a day trip, or a full vacation, Sutrulam crafts personalized travel plans based on your preferences.

Sutrulam helps you plan the perfect trip — to any destination, on any budget, at any time! It doesn’t just give generic suggestions — it creates day-by-day, time-by-time travel itineraries that make exploring simple and stress-free.
What are you waiting for? Let’s start your Sutrulam right now!
features: 🧠 AI Travel Planner: Generates unique itineraries using natural language input.
🏙️ Customizable Trips: Plan for any destination — local, intercity, or international.
👩‍🎓 Student-Friendly: Designed especially for students, but useful for everyone.
⏰ Time-Based Guidance: Get a clear hour-by-hour breakdown for your travel days.
💡 Simple Interface: Clean, responsive UI for quick and easy planning.
